title: Kensan - AI Explorer v2 (Logs approach)
description: Approach 2: Logs panel with formatted columns and built-in expand/collapse

list.name: trace_id
list.label: Trace ID
list.description: Enter a Trace ID to filter events to a specific interaction

panels.title: Completed Interactions — click row to expand full content
panels.description: Approach 2: Each interaction as a log line with fixed-width formatted columns. Click any row to see full details in the expand view.

targets.expr: {job="kensan-ai"} | json | line_format `{{.body}}` | json | event = `agent.complete` | outcome =~ `$outcome` | line_format `[{{.outcome}}] turns={{.total_turns}} tokens={{.total_input_tokens}}+{{.total_output_tokens}} trace={{.traceid}}`

panels.title: Conversation Flow (set trace_id above to filter)
Full Conversation — User / Agent / Tool events
panels.description: Approach 2: Uses Logs panel with color-coded prefixes and built-in expand/collapse. Click any line to see full content in the details pane.

targets.expr: {job="kensan-ai"} | json | traceid =~ `$trace_id` | line_format `{{.body}}` | json | event = `agent.prompt` | line_format `USER     | model={{.model}} | {{.user_message}}`

{job="kensan-ai"} | json | traceid =~ `$trace_id` | line_format `{{.body}}` | json | event = `agent.turn` | line_format `AGENT    | turn={{.turn_number}} in_tok={{.input_tokens}} out_tok={{.output_tokens}} tools={{.tool_call_count}} | {{.response_text}}`

{job="kensan-ai"} | json | traceid =~ `$trace_id` | line_format `{{.body}}` | json | event = `agent.tool_call` | line_format `  TOOL   | {{.tool_name}} ok={{.success}} | in={{.tool_input}} | out={{.tool_output}}`

{job="kensan-ai"} | json | traceid =~ `$trace_id` | line_format `{{.body}}` | json | event = `agent.complete` | line_format `DONE     | outcome={{.outcome}} turns={{.total_turns}} total_in={{.total_input_tokens}} total_out={{.total_output_tokens}} pending={{.pending_action_count}}`

panels.title: Agent Responses (full text per turn)
